text:
leo: planning to ship a preflight + approval-gating flow for runtime.featureflags.rollout tonight. key asks: dry_run simulation, compact preflight report, and an approval gating model that supports expiring and sticky approvals. cc @anya @marc
anya: love the sticky approvals idea. product wants: a single preflight card with risk band, estimated cost/day, delta QPS, top affected orgs, and an Approve button that can be required for enterprise-impacting changes.
marc: security/compliance asks: approvals should support an optional 2FA step for P0 configs, and an expiration TTL. also need an "emergency-exempt" override wire that requires a separate audit entry and a second approver.
sara: observability: preflight should emit config.preflight.risk_score and config.preflight.top_orgs labels, plus sampled traces with header x-rw-preflight. recommend sample_rate=0.5 for WARN/FAIL. include trace_id -> preflight_id mapping in the report.
leo: API sketch: POST /api/configs/preflight_apply?simulate=true -> returns { preflight_id, risk_band, diffs, estimated_qps_delta, estimated_cost_delta, top_orgs }. Also: POST /api/configs/approve with preflight_id and approver metadata. curl example: `curl -X POST /api/configs/approve -d '{"preflight_id":"pf-123","approver":"anya","method":"2fa"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
ops-bot: deploybot: preflight job queued (pf-123). ETA ~5m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
anya: UI idea: Approve button can be toggled to "sticky" for recurrent rollouts of the same key (eg: repeated tuning), with a max_ttl. sticky approvals still require renewal after TTL. product wants a visible expiration time in the console.
marc: implement approval policy: require 2 approvers if top_orgs contains any enterprise tier; require 2FA for P0. emergency override requires a 2nd approver and sets preflight state to "overridden_by_emergency". audit-bot: every approval and override must be recorded with approver id, method, comment, and timestamp.
sara: telemetry gating: add temporary SLOs suggested by preflight: p95_target and ttl. system should auto-pause if p95 > target for > window. preflight report should include suggested sample_rate and temporary SLO to create.
leo: on quota: propose a quota-escrow concept. preflight can optionally reserve headroom for the rollout window so we avoid noisy tenants tripping shared quotas. API: POST /api/quota/escrow -d '{"key":"routing.qps","amount":200,"ttl":"1h","preflight_id":"pf-123"}'
anya: product wants the preflight card to surface a one-click "Escrow quota" action that triggers that API and returns escrow_id. also show how much of quota would be reserved per top org.
marc: audit & compliance: add required comment when approving changes that impact >3 enterprise orgs. store comments in audit log and expose export csv. also we should support an "approval delegation" list so teams can pre-authorize approvers for a timebox.
sara: add a canary header x-rw-canary-id and a small lookup page in console: paste request-id -> returns trace sample + preflight_id + config_version. helps triage.
ops-bot: monitorbot: synthetic preflight simulator started (pf-123). logs at /infra/jobs/pf-123/logs
leo: rollout plan if approved: anneal steps [10,30,60,100] with 20m windows and auto-pause on SLO breach. if emergency-override used, flag the change in the audit log and send an @channel notification with reason.
anya: UI nit: show a short playbook in the card: how to pause, how to escrow quota, how to force-rollback (example curl provided). example rollback: `curl -X POST /api/configs/apply -d '{"key":"runtime.featureflags.rollout","value":0.0}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
marc: security note: approval endpoints must validate caller's 2FA token and that approver is not the original requester unless delegation allows it. record approver IP.
sara: i'll wire up the dashboard panels and add the suggested temporary SLO creation flow. will surface top_org rows and cost deltas.
leo: thanks. i'll push the preview to console and kick the simulator. will await preflight report and approvals before applying. post results here. :rocket:
